title: Repair and re-enable Expense Agent permission and posted-history tests
summary: Expense Agent tests were repaired and re-enabled. The fixes cover permission checks, posted-history fixtures and foreign-currency fixtures, and 14 exclusions were removed from the disabled-test manifest. The Travel Requests API page was also adjusted, and HTTP API test exclusions stay in place.
key_points: Fixed three permission-related tests by organizing permission observations under the correct restricted role before assertions
Replaced invalid posted-history fixture with a properly posted zero-amount line to preserve genuine history
Re-enabled Approve/Submit/Reject Travel Request page-action tests after compilation fix
Classified codeunit 148339 as UnitTest and repaired foreign-currency fixtures in six API tests
Removed 14 role/history/action test exclusions while preserving HTTP API exclusions requiring separate authentication
quote: Fix the three Expense Mgmt. Read/Edit/Admin tests by collecting all nine permission observations under the exact restricted role.
